theorems.name: Submission.indCompact_l1Dual_exists_admissible_ae_tendsto
theorems.statement: ∀ (N : ℕ) (R : ℝ) (s : Rn N → ℝ), 0 < R → AEStronglyMeasurable s volume → (∀ y, |s y| ≤ 1) → (∀ y, y ∉ Metric.ball (0 : Rn N) R → s y = 0) → ∃ ψ : ℕ → Rn N → ℝ, (∀ j, ContDiff ℝ 1 (ψ j)) ∧ (∀ j, HasCompactSupport (ψ j)) ∧ (∀ j, tsupport (ψ j) ⊆ Metric.ball (0 : Rn N) R) ∧ (∀ j y, |ψ j y| ≤ 1) ∧ ∀ᵐ y ∂(volume : Measure (Rn N)), Tendsto (fun j ↦ ψ j y) atTop (𝓝 (s y))
